missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Красота' is the feminine nominative subject of 'поражает'. 'Всех' is the accusative object of the verb.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Красоту' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'ценит'. 'Природы' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Красоты' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express absence. 'В этом городе' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Красоте' is the dative governed by 'удивились', which takes a dative complement. 'Картины' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Красотой' is the instrumental required by 'любоваться'. 'Заката' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В красоте' uses the prepositional after 'в' to locate the quality. 'Тайна' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О красоте' uses the prepositional after 'о' for the object of dreaming. 'Она' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Красота' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Настоящая' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of quantity. 'Красот' takes the genitive plural after 'много', here meaning beautiful things. 'Разных' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Красоты' is the nominative plural subject, meaning scenic beauties. 'Незабываемы' is the short-form predicate agreeing in the plural.
